subject: FieldBridge connector: DPA/MSA carveouts and SOW clarifications
messages:
From: Alex Chen <alex@fieldbridge.io>
To: Kimberley Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Cc: Legal Ops <legal@fieldbridge.io>
Date: Wed, 30 Jun 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: FieldBridge connector — DPA/MSA scope questions

Hi Kimberly,

Thanks for the demo last week — the connector looks strong and the product team is excited about the timeline. Legal asked me to surface a couple of items before we finalize procurement:

- DPA scope: FieldBridge will be pulling customer metadata and limited PII through the connector. Our DPA team wants to understand whether Redwood stores a persistent copy of any customer uploads or only proxies traffic.
- MSA warranty carveouts: we have standard limitations for third-party connectors (indemnity + narrow warranty). Can you confirm Redwood is willing to accept the limit-of-liability cap of $1M for connector usage only?
- SOW attachment: we need a clearer operational runbook for on-boarding and support SLAs (priority/response times).

Attaching our standard DPA redlines for reference (fieldbridge_dpa_redlines.pdf). Would you prefer a marked-up MSA or a short exception list that we can fold into the SOW?

Next steps: if you can share Redwood's redlines or a short exception log by EOD Friday we can escalate to procurement.

Thanks,
Alex Chen
Head of Partnerships — FieldBridge
alex@fieldbridge.io

[attachment: fieldbridge_dpa_redlines.pdf (PDF, 245KB)]

From: Kimberley Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Alex Chen <alex@fieldbridge.io>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 30 Jun 2027 11:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: FieldBridge connector — DPA/MSA scope questions

Alex —

Thanks for the clear summary and the redlines. Quick responses inline:

- Data persistence: Redwood's hosted connector does not persist customer files by default; we stream and keep KV cache for live sessions (configurable TTL). For customers who opt into "sync" features we persist encrypted objects and can offer a retention window (typical defaults: 30/90/365 days). We can surface explicit config options in the SOW runbook.
- Liability cap: For connector-only usage we typically accept a $1M cap, provided the customer is not using a bespoke Dedicated deployment. We will flag this clause for legal review.
- SOW runbook: Marcus will draft a concise onboarding runbook and SLA table (response times, escalation path, ops contacts).

I've attached Redwood's suggested exception log (short format) rather than a full MSA redline to keep the loop light — see "redwood_connector_exceptions.xlsx" (stub). If FieldBridge wants a full MSA redline we can do that but it will add a 1–2 day cycle.

Action items:
- Marcus: draft onboarding + SLA table and a short DPA carveout explanation by Thu 7/1 noon PT.
- Alex: confirm whether FieldBridge will require persisted sync for any pilot customers (yes/no).

Thanks —
Kimberly Park
Senior Partnerships Manager — Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.com

[attachment: redwood_connector_exceptions.xlsx (XLSX, 12KB)]

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Kimberley Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Alex Chen <alex@fieldbridge.io>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 01 Jul 2027 09:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: FieldBridge connector — DPA/MSA scope questions

All —

Drafting the runbook now. High-level clarifications I'm proposing in the SOW:

1) Data handling: "Connector traffic is proxied by default. Any persisted sync requires explicit opt-in by the customer and will be encrypted at rest with a KMS-managed key; retention windows are configurable per-account."
2) Support SLA: Priority 1 (service down) — 1 hour initial response, 4 hour remediation target; Priority 2 — 4 hour initial response, 24–48 hour remediation; business hours vs 24x7 options in SOW.
3) Liability carveout: Limit-of-liability for connector operations capped at $1M for hosted connectors. Excluded for Dedicated/on-prem installs.

Question for FieldBridge (Alex): for the pilot, do you expect any customers to require EU data residency for connector processing? If so we will need to scope a regional deployment or confirm routing controls.

I'll attach a short SOW snippet and the SLA table to this thread by EOD.

— Marcus
Marcus Lin
Platform Partnerships — Redwood Inference
marcus_lin@redwood.com

[attachment: connector_sow_v2.docx (DOCX, 38KB)]

From: Legal Ops <legal@fieldbridge.io>
To: Kimberley Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Alex Chen <alex@fieldbridge.io>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 02 Jul 2027 16:40:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: FieldBridge connector — DPA/MSA scope questions

Kimberly / Marcus —

Thanks for the quick turnaround and the clear SOW/SLA proposal. FieldBridge legal reviewed Marcus's snippet and we have the following responses:

- Data persistence language: acceptable with one tweak — please add explicit wording that Redwood will provide an "erasable" retention window (customer can request deletion and we will purge within the configured retention plus a 48-hour processing window).
- Liability cap: agreed to $1M for hosted connectors. We will reserve the right to re-open for Dedicated installations.
- EU residency: for our EU pilot customers, we will require data processing to remain within EU regions. We would prefer Redwood to confirm whether regional routing can be enforced per account or if a separate regional deployment is required.

Attached is FieldBridge's updated SOW (connector_sow_v2.docx) with the erasable retention language and a DocuSign request for the SOW scope only. Once Redwood confirms the regional routing option we'll finalize the DPA.

DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/sign/abc123-fieldbridge-sow
HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/123456/company/FB-2027-042

Next steps:
1) Kimberly/Marcus: confirm erasable retention acceptance and whether Redwood can support per-account regional routing (or timeline for regional deployment). Please respond by COB Monday 7/5 so procurement can proceed.
2) Alex: preparing commercial SOW for signature once we confirm the above.

Best,
